name: percia-sdks
description: Percia SDKs, CLI, Postman collection and templates, generated from the Percia OpenAPI document.

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @percia/sdk generate && node postman/scripts/generate.mjs && python3 python/scripts/generate.py
scripts.generate:check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- typescript/src/generated python/percia/_generated postman
